description.en: The unique ID of the application.

description.zh:
支持汉字、英文字母、数字、英文格式的下划线，且必须以字母或汉字开始，4~26个字符，1个中文汉字算2个字符。

若不修改，可不传该参数。
description.en:
The application name. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (\_). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. The name must be 4 to 26 characters in length. Each Chinese character is counted as two characters.

Omit this parameter if you do not want to modify the application name.

description.zh:
APP描述信息，长度不超过180个字符。

若不修改，可不传该参数。
description.en:
The description of the application. The description can be up to 180 characters in length.

Omit this parameter if you do not want to modify the description.

description.zh: 指定规则所适用的对象标签，可设置多个。
description.en: The object tags to which the rule applies.

description.zh:
标签键。

n 的取值范围为 `[1, 20]`
description.en:
The tag key.

The range for n is `[1, 20]`.

description.zh:
标签值。

n 的取值范围为 `[1, 20]`
description.en:
The tag value.

The valid range for n is `[1, 20]`.

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向调用API的用户
- 可修改**AppName**或者**Description**，若两个属性都为空，则不做修改，直接返回成功
- 该接口调用的QPS限制为：单用户QPS不超过50
descriptions.en:
- This operation is intended for API callers.

- You can modify the **AppName** or **Description** parameter. If you do not specify these parameters, the application is not modified, but a success message is returned.

- The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 50 for each user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi modify-app --app-id 20112314518278 --app-name jiedian_pord --description modidyTest --tag Value=value Key=key --extend 110461946884 --disabled true --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi ModifyApp --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key --Description modidyTest --AppId 20112314518278 --Extend 110461946884 --Tag.1.Value value --Disabled true --AppName jiedian_pord
